snippet.title: Get Your Free Christmas Tree : Volume I - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Follow the mod on Moddb - https://www.moddb.com/mods/get-your-free-christmas-tree

City 17 is in for a long, cold Winter...

The anarchy that followed the death of the Consul by Santa Claus' hands has resulted in the hunting for 3 Christmas artifacts, the forming of several citizen factions, and your quest to retrieve MacGuffins in the possession of charismatic idiots.

Create allies. Create corpses. All in your path to salvation. Who will you amend with and who will you betray? Will you learn that your actions have consequences? Solve puzzles, ask around, make friends and outwit your enemies in uniquely designed scenarios from the depths of City 17 and beyond.

The Power of God only belongs to the strongest... Or so they say. Find out the truth in your own path and collect the Christmas artifacts across an epic journey spanning mine carts, trains, roads, and festive snow-covered terrain stained in blood and bullets. 

One Man Army Studios presents Get Your Free Christmas Tree. A modification for the leaked Half-Life 2 beta engine. 
In development for a year, GYFCT offers a unique experience detached from the common notions of Half-Life lore to bring the spirit of Christmas to the dark and gritty world of City 17.

Follow us on social media:
Vk - https://vk.com/one_man_army_studios
Moddb - https://www.moddb.com/company/one-man-army-studios

Song Name: Midnight Romeo - Disco Bells

One Man Army Studios 2023
